# Write for the owner

Explain the purpose and recommendation in plain language. Put enough context before the detail that a teammate unfamiliar with the work can follow. Separate findings from assumptions and owner-supplied facts. Use clear headings, complete sentences and concrete next steps. Keep machine metadata separate from the readable report.

Read agent-files/00-context/voice-guide.md for the proposed public writing style. Owner-facing language does not automatically become the public brand voice. Do not impersonate the owner's first-hand experience or reuse another company's claims.
